<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/story-tabs.ts -->
<!--
  A story in steps (years or slides). Axes: layout (years: a row of year tabs over the panel of the active year
  with its badge, step, title, text and tag; carousel: the heading beside a picture with previous and next
  arrows and one dot per step), tone. Choosing a step emits `select`.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { StoryLabels } from "./story-tabs.types";
import type { Milestone } from "./milestone-timeline.types";

export type StoryTabsProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  badge?: string;
  steps: Milestone[];
  active: string;
  labels: StoryLabels;
  layout?: "years" | "carousel";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import StoryDots from "../components/story-dots.vue";
import StoryPanel from "../components/story-panel.vue";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  badge = "",
  steps,
  active,
  labels,
  layout = "years",
  tone = "default",
} = defineProps<StoryTabsProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ select: [id: string] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    v-if="((layout as string) === 'years')"
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge }"
    :tone="tone"
  >
    <Box class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4" data-testid="story-tabs">
      <Button v-for="s in steps" :key="s.id"
        :variant="((s.id === active) ? 'default' : 'outline')"
        size="lg"
        type="button"
        class="h-auto flex-col items-start gap-0 py-2 text-start"
        data-testid="story-tab"
        :data-active="((s.id === active) ? 'true' : 'false')"
        @click="() => emit('select', s.id)"
      >
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
          {{ s.date }}
        </Text>
        <Text size="xs">
          {{ s.tag }}
        </Text>
      </Button>
    </Box>
    <template v-for="(s, i) in steps" :key="s.id">
      <StoryPanel v-if="(s.id === active)" :s="s" :index="i" :total="(steps?.length ?? 0)" :labels="labels" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
  <SectionFrame v-else
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge }"
    :tone="tone"
    layout="split"
    :media="{ show: true }"
  >
    <template #aside>
      <Stack gap="4" align="stretch">
        <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="4/3" />
        <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            layout="icon"
            type="button"
            :aria-label="labels.previous"
            data-testid="story-arrow"
          >
            <LucideIcon name="chevron-left" :size="16" />
          </Button>
          <StoryDots :steps="steps" :active="active" />
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            layout="icon"
            type="button"
            :aria-label="labels.next"
            data-testid="story-arrow"
          >
            <LucideIcon name="chevron-right" :size="16" />
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Stack>
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
